root_cause.text: Uninitialized padding in struct iw_point on 64-bit architectures causes kernel stack memory to be leaked to user space when the struct is copied without zeroing the entire structure.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states "struct iw_point has a 32bit hole on 64bit arches" and "Make sure to zero the structure to avoid disclosing 32bits of kernel data to user space." The patch adds a `memset(&iwp, 0, sizeof(iwp))` before assigning fields in both `compat_standard_call` and `compat_private_call`.
